outcome: density and neuronal activity of tuberomammillary nucleus (TMN) neurons (ADA and c-Fos)
cohort: The study included asphyxia-exposed rats and caesarean-delivered control rats.
finding: Asphyxia-exposed rats exhibited decreased ADA density and c-Fos activity in the TMN, reduced HDC expression in the hypothalamus, and poorer object recognition memory compared to controls, which was reversed by the H3 antagonist thioperamide.
